senses.en: a saw with a fine blade, used for cutting metal

example.en: He used a hacksaw to cut through the metal pipe.
example.zh: 他用钢锯锯断了金属管。

senses.en: living an immoral life of drinking, sex, etc.; lacking moral restraint

example.en: He led a dissolute life in his youth.
example.zh: 他年轻时过着放荡的生活。

senses.en: lack of self-confidence; shyness

example.en: His diffidence kept him from speaking up in meetings.
example.zh: 他的羞怯使他在会上不敢发言。

senses.en: to roll up and fasten something such as a sail or umbrella

example.en: The sailors furled the sails before the storm arrived.
example.zh: 水手们在暴风雨来临前卷起了船帆。

senses.en: the female reproductive cell; an egg cell

example.en: An ovum is released from the ovary each month.
example.zh: 每个月会有一个卵子从卵巢排出。

senses.en: too ready to criticize; judging extremely severely

example.en: A hypercritical teacher can discourage students from trying.
example.zh: 过分挑剔的老师会让学生不敢尝试。

senses.en: the quality of being easy to see through

example.en: The transparency of the glass lets plenty of light into the room.
example.zh: 玻璃的透明度让充足的光线进入房间。

senses.en: openness; the practice of sharing information openly

example.en: The company promised greater transparency in its financial reports.
example.zh: 公司承诺在财务报告中提高透明度。

senses.en: for or from each one of a group; each

example.en: The tickets cost ten dollars apiece.
example.zh: 票每张十美元。

senses.en: the bottom or lower surface of something

example.en: Check the underside of the car for rust.
example.zh: 检查一下汽车底部有没有生锈。

senses.en: a pointed wooden or metal post driven into the ground

example.en: They tied the tent to a wooden stake.
example.zh: 他们把帐篷系在一根木桩上。

senses.en: money risked in a bet or gamble; a share or interest in a business

example.en: He has a large stake in the company.
example.zh: 他在该公司持有大量股份。

senses.en: to risk money or something valuable on a result

example.en: He staked all his savings on the new business.
example.zh: 他把全部积蓄都押在了新生意上。

senses.en: the protection and careful management of the natural environment
senses.zh: 对自然环境的保护与合理管理

example.en: The group works on wildlife conservation in the region.
example.zh: 该组织致力于该地区的野生动物保护。

senses.en: the careful use of resources to avoid waste or loss
senses.zh: 对资源的节约使用；防止浪费或损失

example.en: Energy conservation can reduce household costs.
example.zh: 节约能源可以降低家庭开支。

senses.en: freedom from arbitrary control or restriction

example.en: The constitution protects the liberty of every citizen.
example.zh: 宪法保护每个公民的自由。

senses.en: freedom to choose or act as one wishes
senses.zh: 自由选择的余地；行动自由

example.en: Employees have the liberty to arrange their own work schedules.
example.zh: 员工可以自由安排自己的工作时间。

senses.en: an action taken without asking permission, sometimes regarded as too familiar or disrespectful
senses.zh: 擅自采取的行动；冒失行为

example.en: I hope you don't mind my taking the liberty of borrowing your book.
example.zh: 希望你不介意我擅自借用了你的书。

collocations: take the liberty of doing something

senses.en: a road vehicle with an engine and usually four wheels, used for transporting people

example.en: She bought a new automobile last month.
example.zh: 她上个月买了一辆新汽车。

senses.en: A careful examination of something in order to understand its parts or meaning.
senses.zh: 对某事物进行仔细检查以理解其各部分或含义；分析。

example.en: The report offers a careful analysis of the survey data.
example.zh: 这份报告对调查数据进行了仔细分析。

senses.en: The separation of a whole into its parts for study.
senses.zh: 把整体分解成各部分进行研究；分析。

example.en: Chemical analysis can reveal what a substance contains.
example.zh: 化学分析可以揭示一种物质含有哪些成分。

senses.en: the size or extent of something, especially when large

example.en: The scale of the damage became clear the next morning.
example.zh: 第二天早上，破坏的规模变得清晰起来。

senses.en: an ordered set of levels or numbers used for measuring or comparing

example.en: The form asks people to rate the service on a scale from one to five.
example.zh: 表格要求人们按一到五的等级评价服务。

senses.en: to climb up something steep or high

example.en: The team scaled the mountain before sunrise.
example.zh: 团队在日出前攀登了这座山。

senses.en: someone who examines information or data carefully to find patterns and explain them

example.en: The analyst reviewed the sales figures and identified a clear trend.
example.zh: 分析师查看了销售数据，发现了一个明显的趋势。

senses.en: a financial expert who studies companies or markets and gives business advice

example.en: A financial analyst recommended buying the stock after reviewing the company's earnings.
example.zh: 一位金融分析师在审阅公司收益后建议买入该股票。

senses.en: a formal dinner for many people, often to celebrate something

example.en: The company held a banquet to celebrate its anniversary.
example.zh: 公司举办了一场宴会庆祝周年纪念。

senses.en: to entertain someone with a large meal, or to eat a large meal

example.en: They banqueted the visiting delegation on the first evening.
example.zh: 他们在第一个晚上宴请了来访代表团。

senses.en: to reduce or cancel the effect of something by taking opposite action

example.en: Regular exercise can counteract the effects of stress.
example.zh: 经常锻炼可以抵消压力的影响。

senses.en: causing severe damage, harm, or disability
senses.zh: 严重的；造成严重损害的

example.en: The country suffered a crippling economic crisis.
example.zh: 该国遭受了严重的经济危机。

senses.en: making someone unable to move or function normally
senses.zh: 使人残疾的；使人丧失行动能力的

example.en: Arthritis can be a crippling disease in old age.
example.zh: 关节炎在老年时可能成为使人丧失行动能力的疾病。

senses.en: relating to an organization or the way it is structured and run

example.en: She improved the company's organizational structure.
example.zh: 她改进了公司的组织结构。

senses.en: to discourage someone from doing something

example.en: High fines may deter people from speeding.
example.zh: 高额罚款可能会威慑人们超速行驶。

senses.en: a state of wild excitement or uncontrolled activity

example.en: Fans rushed the stage in a frenzy.
example.zh: 歌迷们疯狂地冲上舞台。

senses.en: happening near the beginning of a period of time, or before the usual or expected time

example.en: She takes an early train to work.
example.zh: 她乘早班车去上班。

senses.en: existing or happening near the beginning of a development or process

example.en: The early Christian church faced many challenges.
example.zh: 早期的基督教会面临许多挑战。

senses.en: before the usual or expected time; near the beginning of a period

example.en: We arrived early and got good seats.
example.zh: 我们到得早，占到了好座位。

senses.en: to travel through the air in a plane or like a bird

example.en: We will fly to Beijing tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 我们明天早上将乘飞机去北京。

senses.en: to move or pass very quickly
senses.zh: 飞速移动；飞驰；（时间）飞逝

example.en: Time flies when you are having fun.
example.zh: 快乐的时候时间过得飞快。

senses.en: a small two-winged insect, such as a housefly

example.en: A fly kept buzzing around the kitchen table.
example.zh: 一只苍蝇一直在餐桌旁嗡嗡地飞。

senses.en: a loud excited shout or cry

example.en: She gave a whoop of joy when she heard the news.
example.zh: 听到消息时，她欢呼了一声。

senses.en: to shout loudly with excitement or joy

example.en: The fans whooped when their team scored.
example.zh: 球队进球时，球迷们高声欢呼。

senses.en: a high-pitched sound made when breathing in after a fit of coughing
senses.zh: （一阵剧烈咳嗽后吸气时的）高调吼声

example.en: The nurse heard a high-pitched whoop as the patient breathed in after coughing.
example.zh: 护士听到病人咳嗽后吸气时发出高调的吼声。

senses.en: a violent rotating windstorm, especially in the Indian Ocean and South Pacific regions

example.en: The cyclone destroyed hundreds of homes along the coast.
example.zh: 气旋摧毁了沿海数百座房屋。

senses.en: the quality of being out of place or inconsistent

example.en: There is a comic incongruity in seeing a formal suit at the beach.
example.zh: 在海滩上看到穿正装的人有一种滑稽的不协调感。

senses.en: plural of millennium: periods of a thousand years

example.en: These ruins have stood for millennia.
example.zh: 这些遗迹已矗立数千年。

senses.en: strong and healthy, especially in old age

example.en: My grandfather is still hale at eighty.
example.zh: 我祖父八十岁仍很健壮。

senses.en: to pull or drag someone forcibly

example.en: The police haled him away for questioning.
example.zh: 警察强行把他带走问话。

senses.en: relating to the medical care of animals

example.en: The injured dog was taken to the veterinary clinic.
example.zh: 受伤的狗被送到了兽医诊所。

senses.en: an antibiotic produced from a mold, used to treat infections

example.en: Penicillin is used to treat many bacterial infections.
example.zh: 青霉素被用于治疗多种细菌感染。

senses.en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice

example.en: She squeezed a lemon into the tea.
example.zh: 她往茶里挤了一个柠檬。

senses.en: something defective or unsatisfactory, especially a car
senses.zh: 次品；不合格的东西（尤指汽车）

example.en: The used car turned out to be a lemon.
example.zh: 那辆二手车结果是个次品。

senses.en: pale yellow in color

example.en: She wore a lemon dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条淡黄色连衣裙去参加聚会。

senses.en: the tree that produces lemons

example.en: The garden has a lemon tree and two orange trees.
example.zh: 花园里有一棵柠檬树和两棵橙树。

senses.en: a feeling of worry or pressure caused by difficulties
senses.zh: 因困难而产生的担忧或压力

example.en: She has been under a lot of stress at work.
example.zh: 她工作中一直承受很大压力。

senses.en: to emphasize something

example.en: He stressed the need for careful planning.
example.zh: 他强调了仔细规划的必要性。

senses.en: internal force per unit area within a material when it is under a load
senses.zh: （力学）应力，即材料受载时内部单位面积上的力

example.en: The bridge collapsed under the stress of heavy traffic.
example.zh: 这座桥因繁忙交通带来的沉重荷载而坍塌。

senses.en: extra emphasis given to a syllable or word when speaking

example.en: The stress is on the first syllable.
example.zh: 重音落在第一个音节上。

senses.en: a substance used to treat or prevent illness

example.en: The doctor prescribed a drug to lower her blood pressure.
example.zh: 医生开了一种降压药。

senses.en: a substance taken for its effects on the mind or body, sometimes illegally
senses.zh: 影响精神或身体的药物；毒品（有些属非法使用）

example.en: Police found illegal drugs in the car.
example.zh: 警方在车里发现了毒品。

senses.en: to give someone a drug, often to make them unconscious or calm
senses.zh: 给…用药（常指麻醉或镇静）

example.en: They drugged him before the operation.
example.zh: 手术前他们给他用了药。

senses.en: in the role, function, or capacity of

example.en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
example.zh: 她在当地医院当护士。

senses.en: because; since

example.en: As it was raining, we stayed indoors.
example.zh: 因为当时在下雨，我们待在室内。

senses.en: while; at the same time that

example.en: He called me as I was leaving.
example.zh: 我正要离开时，他给我打了电话。

senses.en: used to show equality in a comparison

example.en: She is as tall as her brother.
example.zh: 她和她哥哥一样高。

senses.en: a tested explanation of how or why something happens in nature
senses.zh: 经过检验的自然现象解释；学说；理论

example.en: The theory explains how the disease spreads.
example.zh: 这个理论解释了这种疾病是如何传播的。

senses.en: an idea or opinion that someone believes but has not proved

example.en: She has a theory about why the meeting was canceled.
example.zh: 她对于会议为什么取消有一个推测。

senses.en: abstract ideas or principles rather than practical experience

example.en: In theory, the plan should work, but it may be too costly.
example.zh: 理论上，这个计划应该可行，但可能成本太高。

senses.en: a soft fabric with a smooth dense pile

example.en: She wore a dark green velvet dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条深绿色天鹅绒连衣裙去参加聚会。

senses.en: soft and smooth like velvet
senses.zh: 柔软光滑的；天鹅绒般的

example.en: The cat's fur felt velvet to the touch.
example.zh: 这只猫的毛摸起来像天鹅绒一样柔软光滑。

senses.en: (of a job or situation) easy and pleasant, often with good pay

example.en: He landed a velvet job with short hours and high pay.
example.zh: 他找到了一份时间短、薪水高的轻松工作。

senses.en: extreme, intense anger

example.en: She slammed the door in a fury.
example.zh: 她愤怒地砰地关上了门。

senses.en: violent force or intensity, as of weather or action

example.en: The storm hit the coast with fury.
example.zh: 风暴猛烈地袭击了海岸。

senses.en: the story of a person's life written by that person

example.en: She is writing an autobiography about her years as a diplomat.
example.zh: 她正在写一本关于自己外交官岁月的自传。

senses.en: a political and economic theory advocating that the community or state owns and controls the means of production

example.en: Socialism emphasizes equality and public ownership of major industries.
example.zh: 社会主义强调平等和主要产业的公有制。

senses.en: a political movement based on socialist ideas

example.en: Socialism grew rapidly among workers in the 19th century.
example.zh: 社会主义运动在19世纪的工人中迅速发展。

senses.en: to make someone or yourself used to something

example.en: She had to accustom herself to the cold weather.
example.zh: 她不得不让自己适应寒冷的天气。

senses.en: to pay money regularly to receive a service, magazine, or channel

example.en: I subscribe to a weekly news magazine.
example.zh: 我订阅了一份每周出版的新闻杂志。

senses.en: to agree with or support an idea or opinion

example.en: I don't subscribe to that way of thinking.
example.zh: 我不赞同那种思维方式。

senses.en: to sign your name on a document

example.en: All parties must subscribe to the agreement.
example.zh: 各方都必须在协议上签字。

senses.en: a quick, rough drawing made without much detail

example.en: She made a quick sketch of the mountain before it got dark.
example.zh: 天黑之前，她快速画了一幅那座山的素描。

senses.en: a short, humorous performance or piece of writing

example.en: The comedy sketch made everyone in the audience laugh.
example.zh: 那个喜剧小品让观众们都笑了。

senses.en: to make a quick, rough drawing of something

example.en: He sketched the old bridge in his notebook.
example.zh: 他在笔记本上画下了那座老桥的速写。

senses.en: to describe something briefly, giving only the main points

example.en: The manager sketched out the plan for the new project.
example.zh: 经理简略地介绍了新项目的计划。

senses.en: a device that controls the flow of liquid from a pipe or tank

example.en: Please turn off the faucet after washing your hands.
example.zh: 洗完手后请关上水龙头。

senses.en: the act of achieving a goal

example.en: The attainment of peace took years of negotiation.
example.zh: 和平的实现花了多年谈判。

senses.en: an achievement or skill someone has gained

example.en: Her academic attainments impressed the admissions committee.
example.zh: 她的学术成就给招生委员会留下了深刻印象。

senses.en: light or the act of lighting something

example.en: The room's illumination was too dim for reading.
example.zh: 房间的照明太暗，不适合阅读。

senses.en: clarification or insight; spiritual enlightenment

example.en: She spoke with the illumination of someone who truly understood.
example.zh: 她讲得透彻明晰，像一个真正理解的人。

senses.en: a decision not to vote or not to take part in something

example.en: Twelve members voted for the proposal, with three abstentions.
example.zh: 十二名成员投票赞成该提案，三人弃权。

senses.en: the act of refraining from something, especially drinking alcohol

example.en: His abstention from alcohol improved his health.
example.zh: 戒酒使他的健康状况得到改善。

senses.en: a return to an earlier state or condition

example.en: The country's reversion to old habits worried economists.
example.zh: 该国旧习惯的回潮令经济学家担忧。

senses.en: (law) the right of future possession of property returning to the original owner

example.en: The land's reversion to the original family was confirmed in court.
example.zh: 土地归复原主的权利在法庭上得到了确认。

senses.en: threatening harm; evil or menacing in appearance

example.en: He gave me a baleful look from across the room.
example.zh: 他从房间另一头恶狠狠地瞪了我一眼。

senses.en: able to produce many offspring or much vegetation; fertile

example.en: The fecund soil produced abundant crops.
example.zh: 肥沃的土壤出产了丰收的庄稼。

senses.en: producing many ideas or works; creative

example.en: She had a fecund imagination.
example.zh: 她有着丰富的想象力。

senses.en: a long eventful journey full of adventures
senses.zh: 漫长而充满波折的旅程；冒险历程

example.en: Her career was an odyssey through many countries.
example.zh: 她的职业生涯是一段跨越多国的漫长旅程。

senses.en: a Greek epic poem attributed to Homer about Odysseus's journey

example.en: Students read the Odyssey in their literature class.
example.zh: 学生们在文学课上阅读《奥德赛》。

senses.en: to gradually take more of someone's space, rights, or time

example.en: New buildings are slowly encroaching on the old farmland.
example.zh: 新建筑正在慢慢侵占旧农田。

senses.en: not willing to change or compromise

example.en: The manager was inflexible about the deadline.
example.zh: 经理对截止日期毫不让步。

senses.en: stiff and unable to bend

example.en: The old pipe had become inflexible over time.
example.zh: 旧管子随着时间变得僵硬了。
